REJECT

By the cognitive-complexity rules, the extracted blocks account for 13 of the original 29 points (3 for the `byName` loop and 10 for the dependency walk). The lines still in `ChangeFilters` add up to about 16 (one early-return guard, the outer `foreach`, two nested `if`s, the inner `foreach` with its `if`, and four boolean-operator sequences in the `inputs` lambdas), so the method is still above the threshold of 15. Behaviour does look unchanged. I couldn't check the build: the repo isn't on this machine, and the new helper signatures rely on type names (`CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`, `JsInventory.Inventory`) that the diff doesn't show.
